text: APPROVE. The extracted `IsFirstPartySource` keeps the original checks in the same order, and the `&& --count == 0` short-circuit still decrements `count` only for first-party files. This removes three nested `if`s and their `||` chain from `AtLeast`, which should bring it well under 15 while adding only one `&&`. The helper uses only members that already existed (`SourceExtensions`, `SourceClassifier`, `IsSkipped`), so I see no reason for a build or warning failure, though I could not build it from the diff alone.
